abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects:
Rune of Sundering: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of the target's melee weapons.
Rune of Burning: For the rest of the turn, combat attacks that target that enemy unit score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.
Rune of Shock: The target has Strike-last until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Artillerist's Revenge
abilities.effect: This unit's ranged weapons have Crit (2 Hits) while it has any grudge marks.

abilities.name: Tough as Stone
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for combat attacks that target this unit while every model in this unit is within 3" of an objective you control.

abilities.name: Remember Their Names
abilities.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for this unit's attacks while it has any grudge marks.

abilities.name: SONG OF PERSISTENCE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly LORDS OF THE CLAN PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a friendly LORDS OF THE CLAN MONSTER that is wholly within the creeping overgrowth or that is visible to them and wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, ignore the effect of the ‘Battle Damaged’ ability on the target. In addition, if the chanting roll was 6+, the target has WARD (6+) until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: ANCIENT MIGHT
abilities.effect: This unit can use CHARGE abilities even if it is in combat. If the charge roll is 3 or less when it does so, it does not count as having charged.

abilities.name: JADE WINDS
abilities.declare:
Pick a friendly LORDS OF THE CLAN WIZARD to cast this spell, pick 1 of the friendly MANIFESTATIONS below that is not on the battlefield, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
Gladewyrm
Spiteswarm Hive
Vengeful Skullroot
abilities.effect: If you picked a Gladewyrm or Vengeful Skullroot, set it up wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. If you picked a Spiteswarm Hive, set it up wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

abilities.name: DORMANT HEROES
abilities.declare: If there are more friendly LORDS OF THE CLAN units on the battlefield than there are in reserve, pick a friendly LORDS OF THE CLAN MONSTER unit that has not been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up that unit in reserve as a dormant forest spirit. It has now been deployed.

abilities.name: ELDER AUTHORITY
abilities.declare: You can only use this ability if there is a friendly Awakened Wyldwood on the battlefield.
abilities.effect:
You can set up up to 2 additional Awakened Wyldwoods on the battlefield (an Awakened Wyldwood is a single tree miniature with a crescent- shaped base). The first can be set up anywhere on the battlefield more than 3" from all units, objectives and other terrain features. The second can be set up anywhere on the battlefield wholly outside of enemy territory and more than 3" from all units, objectives and other terrain features.
Designer’s Note: The original Awakened Wyldwood is set up in Step 1 of the deployment phase using the ’Deploy Faction Terrain’ ability. This ability allows you to set up a second and third such terrain feature and is used in Step 3 of the deployment phase, after armies have been deployed.

abilities.name: OUR REACH IS LONG
abilities.effect:
The creeping overgrowth (referenced by other abilities) extends 6" from each terrain feature that has a friendly overgrown token.
Increase this range by 1" for each friendly LORDS OF THE CLAN unit that is wholly outside friendly territory.

abilities.name: ROUSED TO FURY
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 9" of a friendly Awakened Wyldwood to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following units:
A friendly LORDS OF THE CLAN unit that is in reserve as a dormant forest spirit.
A friendly LORDS OF THE CLAN MONSTER that has been destroyed.
Set up the unit you picked, or a replacement unit if you picked a destroyed unit, within 9" of the target, wholly within 6" of that friendly Awakened Wyldwood and not in combat. If you set up a replacement unit, allocate 6 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
Then, remove that friendly Awakened Wyldwood from the battlefield.

abilities.name: REJUVENATING COMPANIONS
abilities.effect: Heal (3) this unit.

abilities.name: CALL FORTH THE FOREST
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly LORDS OF THE CLAN WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: If there are fewer than 9 friendly Awakened Wyldwoods on the battlefield, you can set up an Awakened Wyldwood wholly within 24" of the caster, more than 3" from all objectives and more than 1" from all enemy units and other terrain features. If there are 9 friendly Awakened Wyldwoods on the battlefield, Heal (3) each friendly Awakened Wyldwood instead.

abilities.name: SITE OF SLAUGHTER
abilities.effect: Pick an objective wholly outside friendly territory. That objective is considered by you to be the amphitheatre.

abilities.name: FINISHING MOVES
abilities.effect:
While each model in a unit in this Regiment of Renown is contesting the amphitheatre:
That unit’s melee weapons have Crit (Mortal).
If you control the amphitheatre, if the unmodified hit roll or wound roll for an attack that targets that unit is a 1-4, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

warscrolls.name: High Gladiatrix
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a Coven Matriarch.

abilities.name: PARAGON OF SLAUGHTER
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE INFANTRY unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
If this unit is in combat, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
If this unit is not in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: DANCE OF DEATH
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: CASTLE UP!
abilities.effect: While a non-HERO unit in this Regiment of Renown is within the combat range of and visible to this Regiment of Renown’s HERO, those units are under orders.

abilities.name: FRIENDLY COMPETITION
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for shooting attacks made by non-HERO units in this Regiment of Renown if any enemy models were slain by shooting attacks made by non-HERO units in this Regiment of Renown in the same turn.

abilities.name: RELENTLESS BOMBARDMENT
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that was targeted by this unit’s shooting attacks this phase to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if this unit is under orders. On a 3+, subtract 2 from charge rolls and run rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: FORTIFIED POSITION
abilities.effect:
While this unit is under orders:
This unit’s ranged weapons have Shoot in Combat.
Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target this unit.

abilities.name: BLACKPOWDER SQUIRE
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared a SHOOT ability for this unit and this unit is in combat
abilities.effect: This unit’s Blackpowder Squire is a token. Remove this unit’s Blackpowder Squire from the battlefield, then add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s ranged weapons for the rest of the turn.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a SHOOT ability for this unit and this unit is in combat

warscrolls.name: Fusil-Major on Ogor Warhulk

notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a Freeguild Veteran.

abilities.name: COORDINATE ATTACKS

abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly SIGMARITE units that are under orders that target that enemy unit.

abilities.name: SUMMON KRONDSPINE INCARNATE OF GHUR

abilities.effect: Set up a Krondspine Incarnate of Ghur wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: BATTLE DAMAGED

abilities.name: EVERYONE ABOARD!

abilities.effect: Set up those units in reserve as this unit’s passengers. They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: THIS IS YOUR STOP, MAGGOTS!
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit’s passengers to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Set up each target wholly within 6" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units. In addition, the targets’ melee weapons have Charge (+1 Damage) for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: JUSTICE WILL BE SERVED
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick the Neave Blacktalon in this Regiment of Renown to be the target if it is in combat with an enemy HERO.
abilities.effect: The target can use 2 FIGHT abilities this phase. Each time it does so, if it is in combat with an enemy HERO, all of its attacks must target an enemy HERO. In addition, after the first FIGHT ability is used, the target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

warscrolls.name: Lorai, Child of the Abyss
notes: This unit can only be taken in Neave Blacktalon’s regiment.

abilities.name: NEBULOUS SEA-FOG
abilities.declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while a friendly THE BLACKTALONS unit is wholly within 6" of this unit, if the unmodified hit roll for a shooting attack that targets that unit is 1-5, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

abilities.name: AQUATIC ILLUSIONS
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit.

abilities.name: JUSTICE FROM AZYR
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s Whirlwind Axes for attacks that target a HERO.

abilities.name: VANGUARD CHAMBER
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit can use SHOOT and/or CHARGE abilities even if it used a RUN or RETREAT ability in the same turn.

abilities.name: WINDRIDER
abilities.declare: If this unit is in combat or charged this turn, this unit can make a pile-in move. Then, if this unit is in combat, you must pick 1 or more enemy units to be the target(s) of this unit’s attacks.
abilities.effect: Resolve combat attacks against the target unit(s). Then, roll a dice. On a 3+, remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 3" from all enemy units and wholly within the combat range of a friendly THE BLACKTALONS unit that is not in combat.

warscrolls.name: Neave’s Companions
notes: This unit can only be taken in Neave Blacktalon’s regiment. This unit cannot be reinforced.

abilities.name: SHIELD OF AZYR
abilities.effect: While any friendly THE BLACKTALONS HEROES are wholly within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and those friendly units have WARD (5+).

abilities.name: SUPPLIES DONT COME CHEAP
abilities.declare: Pick a visible terrain feature within 18" of the Codewright in this Regiment of Renown. Each friendly unit wholly within 3" of that terrain feature is a target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, Heal (X) the target, where X is an amount equal to the roll.

abilities.name: NO ONE RIDES FOR FREE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly INFANTRY unit with up to 10 models that is wholly within 9" of the Codewright in this Regiment of Renown and not in combat to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield, then set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: LONG-RANGE SUPPORT
abilities.declare: Pick an objective within 15" of the Codewright in this Regiment of Renown and that no friendly units are contesting. Each unit contesting that objective is a target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each target. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: SPECIALIST GRUNDSTOK AMMUNITION
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase, Reaction: You declared a SHOOT ability for this unit
abilities.declare: Pick Shieldbreaker ammunition or Thunderdrakk ammunition.
abilities.effect:
If all of the attacks made for that SHOOT ability target the same enemy unit, after that SHOOT ability has been resolved, roll a dice and add the number of damage points allocated to the target by that SHOOT ability. If the roll is higher than the target’s Control characteristic, apply the following effect to the target based on the ammunition type picked:
Shieldbreaker: Ward rolls cannot be made for the target until the start of your next turn.
Thunderdrakk: That target has a maximum control score of 1 until the start of your next turn.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a SHOOT ability for this unit

warscrolls.name: Codewright
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a Guild Officer.

abilities.name: ADVISORY ROLE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly SKYFARERS units to be the targets.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects to apply to that target for the rest of the turn:
Seek New Prospects: Add 5 to the target’s control score.
Don’t Argue with the Wind: Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for the target.
There’s No Trading With Some People: The target can use a RETREAT ability and still use SHOOT abilities later in the turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on the target by RETREAT abilities.

abilities.name: ARCANE CHARGE
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick a Place of Power you control to be the target.
abilities.effect: Draw a straight line from the centre of the primary objective to the target. If that line crosses any secondary objectives, the first secondary objective that the line crosses is now the primary objective and all other objectives are now secondary objectives.

abilities.name: ROLLING ASH-CLOUDS
abilities.effect:
While the ash-clouds are low-lying:
Units, terrain features and MANIFESTATIONS cannot be set up in neutral territory.
Units, terrain features and MANIFESTATIONS cannot end a move within neutral territory unless they started that move wholly within neutral territory.
Models, terrain features and MANIFESTATIONS are not visible to other models more than 3" away unless a straight line can be drawn between any points on their bases that does not cross neutral territory.

abilities.name: ECHOES OF BLIGHT CITY
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick an objective to be the target.
abilities.effect: Inflict an amount of mortal damage on each unit (friendly and enemy) contesting the target equal to the Instability level. Then, reset the Instability level to 1.

abilities.name: SACRED QUARRY
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly SYLVANETH unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s attacks while it is wholly within 12" of the enemy general or an enemy WARMASTER.

abilities.name: CRUISING INTO POSITION
abilities.declare: Pick all units in this Regiment of Renown that have not been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up all of those units in reserve plying the winds. They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: THE GOOD SHIP AELSLING
abilities.effect: The Aelsling in this Regiment of Renown has a Health characteristic of 17 instead of 14.

abilities.name: DAREDEVIL DEPLOYMENT
abilities.declare: Pick the Arkanaut Frigate in this Regiment of Renown to use this ability if it is plying the winds.
abilities.effect: Set up the Arkanaut Frigate anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up all other units in this Regiment of Renown wholly within 6" of the Arkanaut Frigate and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: YOU CALL IT YOURS, I CALL IT MINE
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for shooting attacks made by units in this Regiment of Renown that target an enemy unit that is within 6" of an enemy unit that has an enhancement.

abilities.name: GRIZZLED BUCCANEERS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase.
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+:
This unit can immediately use a SHOOT ability as if it were your shooting phase but all of its attacks must target the target enemy unit.
For the rest of the phase, this unit’s Privateer Heavy Weapons have Shoot in Combat.

abilities.name: MEDIUM BOMB RACKS
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that does not have FLY and that this unit passed across this phase to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 6 dice. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: INCOMING!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: ASSAULT BOAT
abilities.declare: This unit cannot use this ability if it is in combat or has used a RUN or RETREAT ability this turn. Pick a number of units up to its Transport Capacity that are wholly within 6" of it, that are not in combat and that have not charged this turn to be the targets. Then, make a charge roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect:
This unit can move a distance up to the value of the charge roll and must end the move within ½" of a visible enemy unit. If it does so:
Remove the targets from the battlefield and set them up again wholly within this unit’s combat range. The targets can be set up in combat.
This unit and the targets have charged, and the targets cannot use another Core ability this phase.
Pick up to 1 of the targets to have STRIKE-FIRST for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: BATTLE DAMAGED
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Heavy Sky Ordnance is 3.

abilities.name: TRANSPORT CAPACITY
abilities.effect: This unit can transport up to 2 friendly KHARADRON OVERLORDS INFANTRY units with a combined model count of up to 12 (see Battle Traits).

abilities.name: CAPTAIN OF THE AELSLING
abilities.declare: Pick an Arkanaut Frigate in this unit’s regiment to be the target. This unit can use this ability while in reserve, and the target can also be in reserve.
abilities.effect: The target has the AELSLING keyword. Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the target’s Boarding Weapons for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: SHE CAN HANDLE IT!
abilities.effect: You can re-roll run rolls and charge rolls for the AELSLING while it is wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: AUXILIARY SKYHOOK
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy MONSTER in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a D3. On a 2+:
Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
Subtract 1 from wound rolls made for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: SIMMERING RAGE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: You must use this ability.
abilities.effect: Gain a number of rage dice equal to your fury level. At the end of the battle round, any unspent rage dice are lost.

abilities.name: RAISING THE HEAT
abilities.effect: If you are the attacker, set your fury level to 1. If you are the defender, set your fury level to 2.

abilities.name: ERUPTION OF FURY
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with that friendly unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the melee weapons that the unit using this ability is armed with. Then, spend up to 3 rage dice.
Resolve a number of combat attacks against the target using the melee weapon you picked equal to the number of rage dice you spent.
Those attacks cannot score critical hits. Instead, for each unmodified hit roll of 6 for those attacks:
Inflict an additional D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit in combat with the unit using this ability.
Your opponent must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7.
For each unmodified hit roll of 1 for those attacks, allocate D3 mortal damage to this unit after the damage sequence has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
Designer’s Note: Rage dice do not add to the Attacks characteristic of the weapon you pick; if you spend 3 rage dice to use this ability, you only make 3 combat attacks.

abilities.name: FIGHT THROUGH THE PAIN
abilities.effect: Before allocating damage to a friendly unit, you can spend any number of rage dice. For each rage dice spent, reduce your fury level by 1, to a minimum of 0, then roll a dice. On a 3+, remove 1 damage point from that unit’s damage pool.

abilities.name: SEARCH THE RUIN
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that does not have an emberstone nugget and is contesting a Sun Seekers objective to be the target.
abilities.effect: Give the target an emberstone nugget. If you are the underdog, the target can immediately move 6" but cannot end that move in combat. The target cannot use the ‘Back to Base Camp’ or ‘Power Through’ ability for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: BACK TO BASE CAMP
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that has an emberstone nugget, was not set up this turn and is contesting a Golden Lions objective to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target’s emberstone nugget.

abilities.name: RUNE OF RESTORED HEARTH
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: If the Runelord in the Regiment of Renown is contesting an objective, for the rest of the battle, units in this Regiment of Renown have WARD (5+) while they are contesting that objective.

abilities.name: WRATH AND RUIN
abilities.declare: Pick the Runelord in this Regiment of Renown to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Roll 6 dice. If the chanting roll was 8+, roll 9 dice instead. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. If 3 or more damage points are allocated to the target as a result of those dice rolls, ignore positive modifiers to save rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.

abilities.declare: Pick another friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR DUARDIN unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. You cannot pick a Longbeards unit.

abilities.effect: This unit can use the ‘Unbind’ ability as if it had WIZARD (1).

abilities.declare: Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR DUARDIN unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of each target’s melee weapons.

abilities.name: SUMMON SOULSNARE SHACKLES
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Soulsnare Shackles endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Soulsnare Shackles endless spell wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Soulsnare Shackles endless spell has 3 parts that must each be set up within 3" of at least 1 other part.

abilities.name: SUMMON MALEVOLENT MAELSTROM
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Malevolent Maelstrom on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Malevolent Maelstrom wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUMMON SUFFOCATING GRAVETIDE
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Suffocating Gravetide on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Suffocating Gravetide wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUMMON PURPLE SUN OF SHYISH
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Purple Sun of Shyish on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Purple Sun of Shyish wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: NAVIGATE THE TUNNELS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 6" of a terrain feature that has a hidden passage token to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 6" of a different terrain feature that has a hidden passage token and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SHIFTING PASSAGES
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick 2 non-FACTION TERRAIN terrain features to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Remove all hidden passage tokens from the battlefield (if any). Then, give each target a hidden passage token.

abilities.name: HUNT OF THE BLOODTHIRSTY SHIVER
abilities.effect:
If both units in this Regiment of Renown are within each other’s combat range, pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn:
Evasive Approach: While both units in this Regiment of Renown are within each other’s combat range, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target them.
Ferocious Attack: While both units in this Regiment of Renown are within each other’s combat range, their Allopex’s Ferocious Bites have Crit (2 Hits).

abilities.name: ENSNARED
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy MONSTER or CAVALRY unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.

abilities.name: BLOODTHIRSTY PREDATORS
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s Allopex’s Ferocious Bite while it is within 6" of any damaged enemy units or while it is within 6" of any enemy units that had any models slain in the same turn.

abilities.name: DETERMINED DEFENDERS
abilities.effect: Add 3 to the control scores of friendly units while they are wholly outside enemy territory.

abilities.name: SECURE THE GATEWAY
abilities.effect: While you control the Place of Power wholly within friendly territory, friendly units’ melee weapons have Anti-charge (+1 Rend) while they are contesting an objective you control.

abilities.name: TOE TO TOE
abilities.effect: Subtract 10 from the control scores of enemy MONSTERS while they are in combat with any units in this Regiment of Renown.

abilities.name: GRIMNIR’S DEFIANCE
abilities.effect: Units in this Regiment of Renown cannot be picked to be the target of RAMPAGE abilities used by enemy units.

abilities.name: DUTY UNTO DEATH
abilities.effect: While any friendly FYRESLAYERS INFANTRY HEROES are wholly within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and those friendly units have WARD (5+).

abilities.name: SMOULDERING BRAZIERS
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: WHIRLWIND OF DESTRUCTION
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons if this unit charged this turn.

abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the target’s Health characteristic. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: HONOUR TO GRIMNIR!

abilities.name: RECLAIMED BY NATURE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: If there are fewer than 3 friendly Awakened Wyldwoods on the battlefield, you can set up an Awakened Wyldwood on the battlefield more than 3" from all objectives and enemy units, more than 12" from all other friendly Awakened Wyldwoods and more than 1" from all other terrain features.

abilities.name: ENDLESS GROWTH
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick each friendly SYLVANETH unit that is wholly within the creeping overgrowth to be the targets.
abilities.effect:
For each target, roll a D3 and pick 1 of the following effects:
Heal (X) the target, where X is equal to the roll.
Return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to the value of the roll.

abilities.name: CREEPING DREAD
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit within the creeping overgrowth to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, the first time your opponent declares a command for the target while it is not wholly within 12" of a HERO in their army, unless your opponent spends 1 additional command point to use that command, the command has no effect, it still counts as being used and the command points spent to use the command are still lost.

abilities.name: MEMORIES OF THE FALLEN
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: For each friendly SYLVANETH unit or friendly Awakened Wyldwood that was destroyed in the previous turn, you can pick a friendly SYLVANETH unit to be a target.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of each target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: SIGMAR’S JUSTICE
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit to be marked for justice. You can pick a unit that is in reserve.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the battle, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by units in this Regiment of Renown that target a unit that is marked for justice.

abilities.name: DUTY BOUND
abilities.effect: While every model in the same unit in the Regiment of Renown is contesting the same objective, add 1 to save rolls and ward rolls for that unit.

warscrolls.name: Toll’s Companions
notes: This unit can only be taken in Callis and Toll’s regiment.

abilities.name: HIDDEN AGENTS
abilities.declare: Pick this unit and a friendly Callis and Toll unit if those units have not been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up those units in reserve in the shadows. They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: SAVIOURS OF CINDERFALL
abilities.effect: While a friendly Callis and Toll unit is within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and that friendly unit have WARD (5+).

abilities.name: EMERGE FROM THE SHADOWS
abilities.declare: Pick this unit if it is in the shadows.
abilities.effect: Set up this unit on the battlefield more than 6" from the enemy mark and more than 9" from all other enemy units. Then, set up the friendly Callis and Toll unit in the shadows wholly within 6" of this unit, more than 6" from the enemy mark and more than 9" from all other enemy units.

abilities.name: RELENTLESS HUNTERS
abilities.declare: This unit can use this ability even if it is in the shadows. If there is no enemy mark, pick an enemy HERO on the battlefield to be the target. If there are no enemy HEROES on the battlefield, pick an enemy non-HERO unit on the battlefield to be the target instead.
abilities.effect: The target is the mark for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: RIGHT TOOLS FOR THE JOB
abilities.effect: Double the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for attacks that target the enemy mark.

abilities.name: SUMMON HORRORGHAST
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Horrorghast on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Horrorghast wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUMMON SOULSCREAM BRIDGE
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Soulscream Bridge on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Soulscream Bridge wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Soulscream Bridge has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: SUMMON LAUCHON THE SOULSEEKER
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Lauchon the Soulseeker on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Lauchon the Soulseeker wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUMMON SHARDS OF VALAGHARR
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Shards of Valagharr endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Shards of Valagharr endless spell wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Shards of Valagharr endless spell has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: HUNTER’S COHESION
abilities.effect:
Each time this Regiment of Renown’s Lord-Aquilor uses its ’Ride the Winds Aetheric’ ability, you can pick all units in this Regiment of Renown that are not in combat to be the targets.
In addition, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by this Regiment of Renown’s Lord-Aquilor and VANGUARD-PALLADORS units that target a HUNTED enemy unit.
Designer’s Note: See the ’Astral Compass’ ability on the Vanguard-Hunters warscroll to see how an enemy unit can become Hunted.

warscrolls.name: Lord-Aquilor
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a Stormcast Exemplar.

abilities.name: VANGUARD CHAMBER
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit can use SHOOT and/or CHARGE abilities even if it used a RUN or RETREAT ability in the same turn.

abilities.name: RIDE THE WINDS AETHERIC
abilities.declare: If this unit is not in combat, you can pick up to 2 friendly VANGUARD-PALLADORS units that are not in combat to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Remove this unit and the targets (if any) from the battlefield. Set this unit up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up each target wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: STAR-MARKED
abilities.effect: Add 2" to this unit’s Move characteristic while a HUNTED enemy unit is on the battlefield. In addition, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s attacks that target a HUNTED enemy unit.

abilities.name: ASTRAL COMPASS
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target has the HUNTED keyword for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: VANGUARD CHAMBER
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit can use SHOOT and/or CHARGE abilities even if it used a RUN or RETREAT ability in the same turn.

abilities.name: CHARGING VOLLEY
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect: This unit can immediately use a Shoot ability as if it were your shooting phase, but all of its attacks must target that enemy unit. This unit’s Starstrike Javelins have Shoot in Combat this phase.

abilities.name: VANGUARD CHAMBER
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit can use SHOOT and/or CHARGE abilities even if it used a RUN or RETREAT ability in the same turn.

abilities.name: DANCING MYSTIFLIES
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability for an unit within 30" of this unit
abilities.effect:
If this unit is not a WIZARD, it can use the ‘Unbind’ ability as if it had WIZARD (1). Otherwise, it can use the ‘Unbind’ ability an additional time each phase.
If this unit successfully unbinds the spell being reacted to and the caster is within the creeping overgrowth, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the caster equal to the difference between the casting roll and the unbinding roll, to a maximum of 6.

extra.reactionTrigger: Opponent declared a SPELL ability for an unit within 30" of this unit

abilities.name: AMULET OF RESONANCE
abilities.effect: If this unit used the ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability this turn or you spent rage dice as part of the ‘Fight Through the Pain’ ability when resolving the damage sequence for this unit this turn, give 1 ritual point to each visible friendly SYLVANETH PRIEST wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: GLAMOURWEAVE
abilities.effect: Each phase, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll and 1 save roll for this unit.

abilities.name: TO THE SHIPS!
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick the Heldenhain or a Sun Seekers objective to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield.

abilities.name: REDEPLOY
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: Each model in that unit can move up to D6". That move cannot pass through or end within the combat range of an enemy unit.

abilities.name: AT THE DOUBLE
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a RUN ability
abilities.effect:
Used By: The unit using that RUN ability.
Do not make a run roll as part of that RUN ability. Instead, add 6" to that unit’s Move characteristic to determine the distance each model in that unit can move as part of that RUN ability.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a RUN ability

abilities.name: ALL-OUT ATTACK
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared an ATTACK ability
abilities.effect:
Used By: The unit using that ATTACK ability.
Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made as part of that ATTACK ability. This also affects weapons that have the Companion weapon ability. For the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from save rolls for the unit using this ability.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared an ATTACK ability

abilities.name: FORWARD TO VICTORY
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability
abilities.effect:
Used By: The unit using that CHARGE ability.
You can re-roll the charge roll.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a CHARGE ability

abilities.name: COUNTER-CHARGE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: That unit can use a CHARGE ability as if it were your charge phase.

abilities.name: GUARDED HERO
abilities.effect:
If this HERO(not MONSTER or WAR MACHINES) is within the combat range of a friendly unit that is not a HERO:
Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target this HERO.
If this HERO is INFANTRY, they cannot be picked as the target of shooting attacks made by models more than 12" from them.

abilities.name: CHAMPION
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of weapons used by champions in this unit. If this unit is a BEAST, this ability affects this unit’s Companion weapons.

abilities.name: DEPLOY FACTION TERRAIN
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly faction terrain feature that has not been deployed to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set up the target faction terrain feature wholly within friendly territory, more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features. After you have done so, it has been deployed.

abilities.name: DEPLOY REGIMENT
abilities.declare: Pick a regiment from your army roster to be the target. No units in that regiment can have already been deployed.
abilities.effect: Keep using DEPLOY abilities without alternating until all units in that regiment have been deployed. You cannot set up units that are not in that regiment on the battlefield or in reserve as part of any of those Deploy abilities.

abilities.name: DEPLOY UNIT
abilities.declare: Pick a unit from your army roster that has not been deployed to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set up the target unit wholly within friendly territory and more than 9" from enemy territory. After you have done so, it has been deployed.

abilities.name: ALL-OUT DEFENCE
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability
abilities.effect:
Used By: A unit targeted by that ATTACK ability.
Add 1 to save rolls for that unit until that ATTACK ability has been resolved.

extra.reactionTrigger: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability

abilities.name: SHOOT
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that has not used a RUN or RETREAT ability this turn to use this ability. Then, pick one or more enemy units as the target(s) of that unit’s attacks (see 16.0).
abilities.effect: Resolve shooting attacks against the target unit(s).

abilities.name: CHARGE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat and has not used a RUN or RETREAT ability this turn to use this ability. Then, make a charge roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: That unit can move a distance up to the value of the charge roll. That unit can move through the combat ranges of any enemy units and must end that move within 1/2" of a visible enemy unit. If it does so, the unit using this ability has charged.

abilities.name: FIGHT
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is in combat or that charged this turn to use this ability. That unit can make a pile-in move (see 15.3). Then, if that unit is in combat, you must pick one or more enemy units as the target(s) of that unit’s attacks (see 16.0).
abilities.effect: Resolve combat attacks against the target unit(s).

abilities.name: NORMAL MOVE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: That unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. That unit cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

abilities.name: RUN
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: Make a run roll of D6. That unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic added to the run roll. That unit cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

abilities.name: RETREAT
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on that unit. That unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. That unit can move through the combat ranges of any enemy units but cannot end that move within an enemy unit’s combat range.

abilities.name: MAGICAL INTERVENTION
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD or PRIEST to use this ability.
abilities.effect: That friendly unit can use a SPELL, PRAYER or BANISH ability (as appropriate) as if it were your hero phase. If you do so, subtract 1 from casting rolls or chanting rolls made as part of that ability.

abilities.name: RALLY
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect:
Make 6 rally rolls of D6. For each 4+, you receive 1 rally point. Rally points can be spent in the following ways:
For each rally point spent, Heal (1) that unit.
You can spend a number of rally points equal to the Health characteristic of that unit to return a slain model to that unit.
You can spend the rally points in any combination of the above. Unspent rally points are then lost.

abilities.name: STANDARD BEARER
abilities.effect: While this unit contains any standard bearers, add 1 to this unit’s control score.

abilities.name: FLY
abilities.effect: As this unit moves, it ignores other models, terrain features and the combat ranges of enemy units. It cannot end its move in combat unless specified in the ability that allowed it to move. Ignore any vertical distance moved for this unit.

abilities.name: WARD SAVE
abilities.effect: In step 1 of the damage sequence (see 18.0), make a ward roll of D6 for each damage point in this unit’s damage pool. If the roll equals or exceeds this unit’s ward value, remove that damage point from the damage pool.

abilities.name: BANISH MANIFESTATION
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD or PRIEST to use this ability, pick a MANIFESTATION within 30" of them that was not summoned this turn to be the target, then make a banishment roll of 2D6. Add 1 to the banishment roll for each additional enemy MANIFESTATION on the battlefield after the first. You cannot pick the same MANIFESTATION to be the target of this ability more than once per turn.
abilities.effect: If the banishment roll equals or exceeds the banishment value listed on the MANIFESTATION’s warscroll, it is banished and removed from play.

abilities.name: SACRED RITES
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly PRIEST to use this ability, then make a chanting roll of D6. On an unmodified chanting roll of 1, remove 1 ritual point from that PRIEST instead of D3.
abilities.effect: Give a number to ritual points to the PRIEST equal to the unmodified chanting roll and do not reset the PRIEST’s ritual points to 0.

abilities.name: POWER THROUGH
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that charged this turn to use this ability, then you must pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target. The target must have a lower Health characteristic than the unit using this ability.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, the unit using this ability can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through and end that move within the combat ranges of enemy units that were in combat with it at the start of the move, but not those of other enemy units. It does not have to end the move in combat.

abilities.name: MUSICIAN
abilities.effect: While this unit contains any musicians, if it uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make one additional rally roll of D6.

abilities.name: UNBIND
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
abilities.effect:
Used By: A friendly WIZARD within 30" of the enemy WIZARD casting the spell.
Make an unbinding roll of 2D6. If the roll exceeds the casting roll for the spell, then the spell is unbound and its effect is not resolved. This reaction cannot be used more than once per casting roll.

extra.reactionTrigger: Opponent declared a SPELL ability

abilities.name: COVERING FIRE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that did not use a RUN ability this turn and that is not in combat to use this ability, then pick the closest enemy unit (to that unit) that can be picked as the target of shooting attacks to be the target. You cannot pick MANIFESTATIONS or faction terrain features as the target of this ability.
abilities.effect: Resolve shooting attacks for the unit using this ability against the target. You must subtract 1 from the hit rolls for those attacks.

abilities.name: ACTIVATE PLACE OF POWER
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly HERO within 3" of any Places of Power to use this ability.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 1, inflict D3 mortal damage on that HERO. On a 2+, pick 1 of the following effects:
Ignite Fury: Gain 2 rage dice, then increase your fury level by 2, to a maximum of 7.
Channel Wrath: If that HERO is a WIZARD or PRIEST, add 1 to casting rolls or chanting rolls for that HERO for the rest of the turn.
Dizzying Rage: For the rest of the turn, if that HERO is not a WIZARD or PRIEST, they can use the ’Unbind’ or ’Banish Manifestation’ ability as if they had WIZARD (1).

abilities.name: REALMROOT GUIDE
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: This unit can only use this ability if it is wholly within the creeping overgrowth. Pick this unit and up to 1 other friendly SYLVANETH unit within this unit’s combat range to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Remove the targets from the battlefield and set them up again wholly within the creeping overgrowth and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SPELLSINGER
abilities.effect:
If this unit is a WIZARD, add 1 to casting rolls for this unit.
If this unit is not a WIZARD, it can use the ‘Unbind’ ability as if it had WIZARD (1).

abilities.name: SPIRIT OF THE DARK FOREST
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy HERO to be the target.
abilities.effect: Halve the target’s Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: ALL THE RAGE
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick a pair of objectives to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the battle round, the target is the coveted pair of objectives instead of the other pair of objectives.

abilities.name: HEARTWOOD HUNTING HORN
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.effect: You gain 1 chord.

abilities.name: A PRIZE QUARRY IS SIGHTED
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 9" of a friendly EVERGREEN HUNT unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target becomes the quarry for the rest of the battle. If there was already a quarry on the battlefield when you declared this ability, that unit is no longer the quarry.

abilities.name: MERCIFUL STRIKE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly EVERGREEN HUNT MONSTER that has not used a RAMPAGE ability this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice and add the number of damage points the target has. If the result exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

abilities.name: QUESTING TENDRILS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick the terrain feature that is closest to the quarry to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, friendly units are wholly within the creeping overgrowth while they are wholly within 6" of the target.

abilities.name: RHYTHM OF THE CHASE
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: If there is no quarry on the battlefield, pick an enemy unit on the battlefield to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target is the quarry for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: ABUNDANT GROWTH
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick each friendly EVERGREEN HUNT unit that is wholly within 3" of a terrain feature to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Heal (1) each target.

abilities.name: NATURE AETHERIC
abilities.declare: Pick a terrain feature that is within friendly territory to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the battle, friendly units are wholly within the creeping overgrowth while they are wholly within 6" of the target.

abilities.name: OPENING HORN BLAST
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: You must use this ability at the start of the battle round.
abilities.effect:
Your chords are reset to 0. Then, you gain 1 chord:
If a friendly Belthanos is on the battlefield.
For each friendly EVERGREEN HUNT unit that is wholly within the same large quarter of the battlefield as the quarry.
For each quarry destroyed so far during the battle.

abilities.name: SONG OF THE HUNT
abilities.effect:
The following cumulative effects apply to friendly EVERGREEN HUNT units depending on the number of chords you have:
1 chord – Simple: Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for friendly units wholly within the same quarter of the battlefield as the quarry.
2 chords – Tuneful: Add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for friendly units’ combat attacks that target an enemy unit wholly within the same quarter of the battlefield as the quarry.
3-5 chords – Melodic: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly units while they are in combat with the quarry.
6+ chords – Mellifluous: While a friendly unit is in combat with the quarry, the quarry has STRIKE-LAST.

abilities.name: SAPWOOD LEADER
abilities.effect: If you pick this unit to be a target of the ’Abundant Growth’ ability, Heal (3) this unit instead of Heal (1).

abilities.name: Itinerant Grimmdron
abilities.effect: If the Grimhold Exile in this Regiment of Renown has used the 'Wrathful Wanderer' ability this battle, remove the other units in this Regiment of Renown from the battlefield and set them up again on the battlefield wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge, wholly within 6" of the Grimhold Exile in this Regiment of Renown and more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, give a unit in this Regiment of Renown 1 grudge mark.

abilities.name: Fury of Grimnir
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Movement Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit has any grudge marks and is not in combat, it can move D6". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat and cannot end that move any further from the closest enemy unit.

abilities.name: Duty unto Death
abilities.effect: While any friendly Grimmdron Infantry Heroes are wholly within this unit's combat range, both this unit and those friendly units have Ward (5+).

warscrolls.name: Grimhold Exile
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as Grimnir’s Chosen.

abilities.name: Alone but Never Outnumbered
abilities.effect: This unit has Strike-first while there are no other friendly units within 6" of it.

abilities.name: Wrathful Wanderer
abilities.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield, then set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Relentless Wrath
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Movement Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit has any grudge marks and is not in combat, it can move D6". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat and cannot end that move any further from the closest enemy unit.

warscrolls.name: Auric Flamekeeper
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as Grimnir’s Chosen.

abilities.name: Masterflame Rune
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly Grimmdron Infantry unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. Then, make a Masterflame rune roll by rolling a dice.
abilities.effect:
On a 1, or if the roll is equal to or less than the number of friendly Khazalite Holds units that have been destroyed during the battle, pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn:
Grimnir's Grit: The target has Ward (5+).
Grimnir's Resolve: You can re-roll charge rolls for the target.
Grimnir's Vengeance: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the target's melee weapons.

abilities.name: Relight the Fire
abilities.effect: If this unit is destroyed, before removing it from play, give each visible friendly Grimmdron unit within 6" of it 1 grudge mark.

abilities.name: Fire-fuelled Anger
abilities.effect: Subtract 2 from Masterflame rune rolls for this unit while it has any grudge marks.

abilities.name: NATURE’S TITANS
abilities.effect: When using the ‘Endless Growth’ ability, do not roll a D3 for MONSTER targets. Instead, Heal (3) each of those targets.

abilities.name: BATTLE DAMAGED
abilities.effect:
While this unit has 10 or more damage points:
The Attacks characteristic of its Crushing Iron Feet is 3.
It has a Control characteristic of 5.

abilities.name: MERCENARY ATTITUDES
abilities.declare: Pick another friendly non-UNIQUE unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn and while the target is wholly within 12" of this unit:
You can re-roll run rolls for the target.
Add 1 to charge rolls for the target.
The target cannot be targeted by shooting attacks.
Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks.
Add 10 to the target’s control score.

abilities.name: FEAR OF THE DEEPWOODS
abilities.effect: In the ‘Creeping Dread’ ability, replace ‘while it is not wholly within 12" of a HERO in their army’ with ‘while it is not wholly within 6" of a HERO in their army’.

abilities.name: CLARIONBUDS
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: If there is an enemy unit wholly within 12" of your Soulpod Grove, pick up to 3 friendly SOULPOD GUARDIANS units to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Remove the targets from the battlefield and set them up again wholly within 12" of your Soulpod Grove and more than 6" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: THE SACRED GROVES
abilities.declare: You must use this ability.
abilities.effect:
Set up 3 Awakened Wyldwoods (an Awakened Wyldwood is a single tree miniature with a crescent-shaped base) wholly within friendly territory, more than 1" from all other terrain features and more than 3" from all objectives. The tips of each crescent-shaped base must touch, forming a circle.
Once you have done so, for the rest of the battle, the 3 tree miniatures join to form 1 Soulpod Grove terrain feature. The area inside the circle formed by the trees is part of the terrain feature

abilities.name: JADE HAVEN
abilities.effect: The Health characteristic of your Soulpod Grove is 18. The creeping overgrowth extends 12" from your Soulpod Grove.

abilities.name: HEART OF THE FOREST
abilities.effect: You cannot allocate more than 10 damage points per phase to a friendly SOULPOD GUARDIANS unit while it is wholly within 12" of your Soulpod Grove (remaining damage points inflicted on it in that phase have no effect).

abilities.name: VENGEANCE FOR THE LOST
abilities.effect: If your Soulpod Grove has been demolished this battle, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of friendly SOULPOD GUARDIANS units’ melee weapons.

abilities.name: CRADLING VINES
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly SOULPOD GUARDIANS WIZARD to cast this spell, pick an objective within 18" of them that has not been picked to be the target of this spell this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 5 to the control scores of friendly units while they are contesting the target objective.

abilities.name: JADE WINDS
abilities.declare:
Pick a friendly SOULPOD GUARDIANS WIZARD to cast this spell, pick 1 of the friendly MANIFESTATIONS below that is not on the battlefield, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
Gladewyrm
Spiteswarm Hive
Vengeful Skullroot
abilities.effect: If you picked a Gladewyrm or Vengeful Skullroot, set it up wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. If you picked a Spiteswarm Hive, set it up wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

abilities.name: DEVOTED PROTECTOR
abilities.effect: If this unit is destroyed while it is wholly within 12" of your Soulpod Grove, before removing this unit from the battlefield, Heal (10) your Soulpod Grove.

abilities.name: SONG OF VENGEANCE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly SOULPOD GUARDIANS PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly SOULPOD GUARDIANS unit that is wholly within 12" of them and not in combat or that is wholly within 12" of your Soulpod Grove to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. The target(s) can move up to 5" and can end that move in combat.

abilities.name: FIERCE COMPETITION
abilities.effect:
Each time a unit in this Regiment of Renown uses an ability and any enemy models were slain by that ability, after that ability has been resolved, the unit that used that ability is pre-eminent and the other unit in this Regiment of Renown is overlooked.
Weapons used by an overlooked unit in this Regiment of Renown have Crit (Auto-wound).

abilities.name: FIRE AND FLIGHT
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a SHOOT ability for this unit
abilities.effect: After that SHOOT ability has been resolved, this unit can move 2D6". It cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a SHOOT ability for this unit

abilities.name: FIGHT AND FLIGHT
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit is in combat, it can move 12". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat. Then, roll a D3 for each enemy unit that this unit passed across during that move. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

abilities.name: INCUBATION PERIOD
abilities.declare: This ability must be used to deploy this Regiment of Renown.
abilities.effect: Set up the units in this Regiment of Renown in reserve festering within. They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: BURSTING WITH LIFE
abilities.effect: If a friendly non-NURGLE’S GIFT unit would be destroyed, before the last model is removed from play, roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll for each other friendly non-NURGLE’S GIFT unit that has been destroyed this battle. On a 5+, pick a friendly unit that is festering within and set it up wholly within 6" of that model. It can be set up in combat.

abilities.name: ENDLESS SWARM
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: This unit can only use this ability if it has been destroyed.
abilities.effect: Set up a replacement unit wholly within 6" of a friendly Feculent Gnarlmaw and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: BEAST
abilities.effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

abilities.name: TRAVEL THE NIDUS PATHS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 12" of a Nidus Path to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 12" of the linked Nidus Path in the opposite corner of the battlefield, more than 9" from all enemy units.
When the underdog uses this ability, they can choose to set up the target wholly within 12" of any Nidus Path and more than 9" from all enemy units instead of the linked Nidus Path in the opposite corner of the battlefield.

abilities.name: ESCAPE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit within 6" of the escape point in enemy territory to use this ability, then pick an objective it is contesting to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target objective and the unit using this ability from the battlefield. That unit has escaped.

abilities.name: GRAB THE REALMSTONE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit to use this ability, then pick an objective it is contesting, that you control and that has not been picked to be the target of this ability this turn to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target objective from the battlefield and set it up again within 3" of the unit using this ability and not on a terrain feature.

abilities.name: THE RITUAL
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit within 3" of the Mother Cauldron to be the target. Then, roll a dice.
abilities.effect: On a 1, the Mother Cauldron is destroyed. On a 2+, the target is destroyed.

abilities.name: SECURE NEW GROUND
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for friendly units’ combat attacks while they contest an objective that you do not control.

abilities.name: RESERVE CONTINGENT
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit in the second turn force or the third turn force that has not been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up that unit in reserve. It has now been deployed.

abilities.name: ARRIVAL OF RESERVES
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit in reserve.
abilities.effect: Set up that unit anywhere wholly within friendly territory more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: BACKBONE OF SUCCESS
abilities.effect: While a non-HERO unit is contesting an objective, HEROES contesting that objective have a maximum control score of 1.

abilities.name: SEISMIC SHIFT
abilities.effect: Remove 1 objective from the battlefield.

abilities.name: TOP OF THE FOOD CHAIN
abilities.declare: Pick 3 friendly units to bе the targets.
abilities.effect: Each target has the PREDATOR keyword for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: THE RITUAL
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Battle Round
abilities.effect:
Gain D6 ritual points if you control the Ritual Site.
Gain D3 ritual points for each Arcane Repository you control.
Lose D3 ritual points for each Arcane Repository that you do not control.

abilities.name: SLAIN ON THE PLACE OF POWER
abilities.effect: Each time an enemy HERO that is contesting an objective is slain by a combat attack made by a friendly HERO, add the Control characteristic of that slain HERO to the control score of that friendly HERO for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: AMBERGLADE NECTAR
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of Companion weapons used by friendly SYLVANETH units for attacks that target that enemy unit.

abilities.name: WYCHWOOD GLAIVE
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it by this unit’s combat attacks this turn to be the target.
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the battle. This unit can use this ability even if it has been destroyed.

abilities.name: SEED OF REBIRTH
abilities.effect: The first time this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, Heal (D3) this unit.

abilities.name: ASPECT OF IRONBARK
abilities.effect:
When resolving the damage sequence for this unit, if you spend rage dice as part of the ‘Fight Through the Pain’ ability, you can re-roll any of the dice that determine whether damage points are removed from this unit’s damage pool.
After the damage sequence has been resolved, if you rolled a total of 10+ on those re-rolls, this ability has no effect for the rest of the battle

abilities.name: SPREADING WARPFIRE
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: If there are no flaming terrain features on the battlefield, pick a non-FACTION TERRAIN terrain feature to be the target. Otherwise, pick a non-FACTION TERRAIN terrain feature that is not flaming and that is within 12" of a flaming terrain feature to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target is flaming for the rest of the battle. Then, inflict D3 mortal damage on each unit (friendly and enemy) within 6" of any flaming terrain features.

abilities.name: TREAD CAREFULLY
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Start of First Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick an objective within friendly territory to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target is no longer stable.

abilities.name: VIOLENT TREMOR
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick a pair of objectives to be the targets.
abilities.effect: The stable target objective is no longer stable. The other target objective is stable instead.
